title: Carry state across sessions
why: Context does not survive a session boundary, so without a state file every session starts by rediscovering where the work stood. The expensive version is not the lost time, it is re-litigating a decision that was already settled because nothing recorded that it was.
fix: Keep one handoff file with a single owner, name it in CLAUDE.md as the first thing to read, and have a command rewrite it at session end. Give it a last-updated stamp so a stale one is visibly stale rather than quietly wrong.
